# DLR broadcast navigation reference

`dlr_nav_2021364.txt` contains E36 I/NAV, E36 F/NAV and C60 records extracted
from the DLR multi-GNSS broadcast file
[`BRDM00DLR_S_20213640000_01D_MN.rnx.gz`](https://igs.bkg.bund.de/root_ftp/IGS/BRDC/2021/364/BRDM00DLR_S_20213640000_01D_MN.rnx.gz).
The compressed source has SHA-256
`28892f5bea36ff05ea1ddb80eccd76ad4c3764bb8bfb6bea58707218be4fffed`.
These records match the ephemerides in the Unicore R1.4 manual examples; the
manual rounds several values and does not identify every RINEX source flag.
